The '''5-BT Threat Analysis Droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].

==Characteristics==
The 5-BT was small and spherical in shape and was designed to accompany VIPs when they went on assignments. The 5-BT was fitted with a number of different sensors, which could be used to check food for [[Poison/Legends|poison]], search for eavesdropping devices and locate any [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. New 5-BTs were sold with a bracelet, which could be worn by the owner. If the droid detected a threat, it would then send a signal to the bracelet, which would cause the bracelet to vibrate, alerting the wearer to the potential danger.

The 5-BT was a precursor design to the [[Mark VII "Inquisitor" Series Seeker Droid]] and a number of other droid designs. It cost 17,490 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.
